# Tier `amd-gcn`

## Serving

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `vulkan` | which `llama-swap.*.yaml` template renders |
| ctx_size | 32768 | the served window (`--ctx-size`) |
| kv_type | `f16` | `--cache-type-k/v`, kept symmetric |
| flash_attn | `on` | `--flash-attn` (required for a q8_0 V cache) |
| resident_tier | `offload-e4b` | the model that stays hot; seeds the agent planner seat (agent_model) when it differs from the workhorse |
| agent_ctx_tokens | 32768 | the agent's `-ctx-tokens` compaction budget |
| 26B-A4B | dropped | whether the 26B MoE is served, and where its experts live |

## Agent seat

This tier declares no persistent vLLM agent seat: the agent lane runs on the
llama.cpp seat named by `agent_model` above, in the tier's own llama-swap config.

## Media

This tier serves these media **seats** — models in its own llama-swap config, rendered
at install time. Each seat also produces the harness config binding that routes to it, so a
binding can never name a seat that was not rendered:

| seat | kind | binds | model | residency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gemma4-e4b-vision` | vision | `vision_model` | `gemma-4-E4B-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf` | swappable |
| `whisper-stt` | stt | `stt_model` | `ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin` | swappable |

A seat still needs its weights on the box — model downloads stay out-of-band, as with
every seed.

These `config_seed` keys are applied to a FRESH harness config exactly like the media

here so they are never mistaken for a media capability:

| `agent_timeout_sec` | `900` |
| `escalation_model` | `` |

| `reasoning_model` | `` |

ANIMATE (engine sdcpp, Wan2.1 VACE 1.3B fp16 .safetensors, Apache-2.0, commercial_use true; the public VACE GGUFs lack vace_patch_embedding.weight and sd-cli refuses them) with the depth-anything.cpp depth-anything2-small q8_0 control video: 288x512x33, 20 steps, cfg 6: 2939 s, 5,760 tokens at width 1536 (animategen_sdcpp_max_tokens 5800, stride 8; 480x832 = 15,600 tokens reset the ring); animategen_frames 33 is the default clip (a request that names no frames renders it: 288x512x33 plus the reference frame is 5,760 tokens, inside the 5800 cap, where the runner's own default of 49 frames would be 8,064 and refused); a request that names more frames than the cap fits is refused before the media lease with token_cap_exceeded. animategen_timeout_sec 5400. VOICE (audio.cpp chatterbox q8_0, MIT, voice clone, RTF about 4.1) and MUSIC (audio.cpp ACE-Step 1.5 turbo bf16, planner exact, 149-165 s per 30 s clip) run on the node's own audio.cpp v0.9.0 native build (no AVX-512 needed) with the Vulkan planner-prefill patch. ACE-STEP LICENCE IS NOT VERIFIED: its commercial_use is deliberately left UNSET (unknown) and must be checked at the ACE-Step source before anything records it. The engine binaries and every weight are out-of-band on Linux (the installer has no media leg for this tier yet), so the seed paths follow the install-home convention and the routes report BOUND-BUT-MISSING until the files are placed. ENGINE PINS (2026-10-08 frontier pick, measured on <node-f>): stable-diffusion.cpp master-945 (decoded frames bit-identical to master-929 on the FastWan run, ~10% faster; the GPU-evidence guard reads both log formats) and audio.cpp v0.9.1 built natively with the same planner-prefill patch (v3). This seed is for 0.173.0 and later: 0.172.0 and earlier do not know these keys.
